title.narrative: Advancing Inclusive AI Policy Development and Strengthening AI Governance

description.narrative:
Artificial intelligence (AI) presents significant opportunities for accelerating digital transformation, improving public service delivery and advancing sustainable development. However, realizing these benefits requires robust governance frameworks, institutional capacities and safeguards to ensure that AI systems are developed and deployed in a manner that is ethical, transparent, accountable and aligned with human rights principles. Following the completion of UNESCO’s AI Readiness Assessment Methodology (RAM) in Bangladesh, important gaps have been identified in policy implementation, legal preparedness, institutional capacity and governance mechanisms required for responsible AI adoption.
This project aims to support Bangladesh in translating AI readiness into implementation by strengthening AI governance capacities, advancing AI policy development and enhancing institutional preparedness across the public sector and judiciary. Drawing on UNESCO’s Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence, the AI and Rule of Law Programme, the Data Governance in the Digital Age initiative and the SPARK-AI Alliance, the project will strengthen capacities to develop and implement inclusive, human rights-based AI governance frameworks and digital transformation policies.
It is expected that, based on the project outcomes, Bangladesh will be better positioned to operationalize key recommendations emerging from the AI RAM process, strengthen governance and oversight mechanisms for AI, improve data governance capacities, and enhance the ability of public institutions to design, regulate and oversee AI systems responsibly. The project will also contribute to ongoing national AI policy development efforts and foster stronger institutional collaboration to support inclusive, ethical and sustainable digital transformation in Bangladesh.
